title: Street Legal Golf Cart Rentals in Vancouver
blurb:
Easily navigate traffic and parking with a street-legal golf cart! You can go almost everywhere in the City with our LSVs, and they're fully electric and so much fun to ride in!

Drive around Stanley Park, stop at the beach, go to Granville Island, or even venture out of downtown to Kits Beach, or even Wreck Beach!

The rental starts when you pick up, and you must return same-day before 11pm. This lets you stop when and where you want, and explore on your own schedule.
